scope: Step 4 evidence/requirement register; mission/equipment optional; numeric operational limits not adopted
comparison_policy_authority: Active comparison policy is compiled separately with its actual values; exploratory, not NASA requirements

rules.title: Finite values, units and declared measurement support
rules.required_inputs: metric; value; unit; scope; support_count; status
rules.effect: Reject inconsistent observed values; missing evidence is not zero or Passed
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Phase summaries are not chronological equipment temperatures
rules.required_inputs: component-response quantity; mission period; local footprint; limits
rules.effect: Retain surface/phase evidence as context; withhold operational thermal conclusions
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Dated polar thermal quality and period support
rules.source: Dar_035 strict zero-flag cohort; conservative analysis policy, not a NASA equipment limit
rules.applicability: Using the frozen dated sample as qualified mission thermal history
rules.required_inputs: strict observations; quality flags; period coverage
rules.effect: Zero strict observations fails this source-use check, not the site; positive counts alone still do not establish a mission history
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Orbital counters/flux cannot substitute for shielded crew dose
rules.required_inputs: local field; transport; shielding; duration; applicable dose/limit
rules.effect: Use orbital variability/quality as context only; no candidate dose cutoff or safety score
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Finite target-center geometry is not power/contact adequacy
rules.required_inputs: validated footprint; horizon/model resolution; solar disk/panel or station/link model; actual period
rules.effect: Keep native regional reference identity; do not attach target-center blockage as component generation/contact history
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Historical capacities and redlines are not modern defaults
rules.source: Dar_033; Apollo 17 primary report Table 9-II and checked contextual pages
rules.required_inputs: document/revision; configuration; quantity/unit; applicability
rules.effect: Retain original units/page references and historical arithmetic; do not adopt stocks, crew or limits
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Missing mandatory evidence never becomes a preference pass
rules.applicability: Only when an operational profile is explicitly requested
rules.required_inputs: complete applicable requirement inventory; qualified evidence; limits
rules.effect: Known mandatory failure dominates Unknown; mandatory Unknown withholds operational ranking; contextual ranking stays separate
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Catalog detections are not local mission-window event rates
rules.required_inputs: event identity/uncertainty; observation effort; event timing; load/vulnerability model
rules.effect: Do not add related catalog counts as independent events or infer low local hazard probability
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Indirect resource/terrain indicators do not prove stocks or strength
rules.required_inputs: local mechanics; extractability; depth/yield; equipment response
rules.effect: No essential consumable credit or foundation/mobility safety pass from imagery, radar or slope
rules.authority: project evidence-use contract

rules.title: Thermal operating/survival protection
rules.applicability: Mandatory where temperature threatens required crew/equipment function
rules.required_inputs: actual component thermal response; applicable operating limits
rules.effect: Outside applicable limits cannot be offset by preferences; unsupported conclusion remains Unknown
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Life-critical power continuity and reserve
rules.required_inputs: dated generation/load; usable storage; losses; reserves
rules.effect: Chronological shortfalls cannot be erased by later sunlight or high mean visibility
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Required communication and allowable outage
rules.source: Research_Notes.md Communications & Geometry; checked historical conditional communication rules
rules.applicability: Mandatory where mission communications are essential
rules.required_inputs: actual contact/link model; stations/relays; permitted outage; contingencies
rules.effect: Mean visibility is not a guaranteed service or a universal Apollo outage cutoff
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Crew/electronics radiation protection
rules.source: Research_Notes.md Radiation; NASA-STD-3001 references S02/S03 (applicability/revision must be selected)
rules.applicability: Mandatory when crew or required equipment exposure is applicable
rules.required_inputs: quantity/units; transported local exposure; protection; duration; applicable limit
rules.effect: Excess applicable exposure/inadequate essential protection cannot be compensated by preferences; no raw counter/flux threshold or cutoff
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Protected atmosphere and essential consumables
rules.source: Research_Notes.md Habitat & Human Health; outline 2.4; Apollo historical configuration
rules.required_inputs: crew; stocks; rates/recovery; pressure/sealing; CO2/heat rejection; reserves
rules.effect: No external breathable air; reference rates or Apollo reserves do not establish current capacity
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Foundation, load and mobility capability
rules.applicability: Mandatory where load support or mobility/return is essential
rules.required_inputs: local soil/traction; structure/vehicle loads; tested limits
rules.effect: Unsupported essential loads/return capability are not soft penalties; slope is not bearing strength
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Seismic, impact, plume/ejecta structural protection
rules.source: Research_Notes.md Seismic Activity and Mission Safety; Dar_034
rules.required_inputs: event/load scenario; location/effort uncertainty; geometry; vulnerability response
rules.effect: Sparse catalogs cannot certify low risk; retain unresolved local hazard evidence
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Dust-related cooling, sealing, optics and wear
rules.source: Research_Notes.md P2 Dust; checked Apollo anomalies/maintenance
rules.applicability: Mandatory if degradation disables an essential function; otherwise possible efficiency preference
rules.required_inputs: surface exposure; hardware-specific degradation; maintenance and response limits
rules.effect: Orbital dust is not local wear/cabin loading; P2 is not permission to ignore a critical hazard
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Charging/plasma effects on required systems
rules.required_inputs: local electrical environment; charging model; qualified hardware tolerance
rules.effect: Plasma context is not an electronics damage rate or crew dose
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Resource dependence and sample/material containment
rules.applicability: Mandatory if mission depends on local supply or hazardous sample handling
rules.required_inputs: extractability/yield; process energy; containment; exposure; stocks
rules.effect: Do not credit unverified resources as essential consumables or equate spectra with cabin toxicology
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Return, workload and contingency resilience
rules.source: Research_Notes.md Mission Safety & Reliability; checked Apollo rules and durations
rules.applicability: Mandatory when mission-critical return/contingency capability is needed
rules.required_inputs: activities; duration; return path/capability; supplies; contingency inventory
rules.effect: Historical planned duration and conditional return/communication rules do not become universal site limits
rules.authority: mission-dependent requirement family, not an adopted numeric limit

rules.title: Apollo usage, prediction deviations and historical redlines
rules.source: Apollo 17 Postflight report Table 9-II, PDF page 144; Dar_033 row-level source SHA/page/review_method
rules.applicability: Original Apollo configuration and source quantities only
rules.required_inputs: original actual/predicted quantities and units; printed redlines; source page
rules.effect: Explain uncertainty/reserve management; historical remaining-minus-redline is not a new mission margin
rules.authority: historical source only

rules.title: Lunar vacuum, unbreathable exterior and body-level conditions
rules.required_inputs: body identity; actual protection when operational assessment requested
rules.effect: Do not fabricate lunar Earth-style wind/humidity or assume protection adequate
rules.authority: planetary baseline
